16975-the-haunted-house-a-true-ghost-sto.title: The Great Amherst Mystery,
16975-the-haunted-house-a-true-ghost-sto.creator: Walter Hubbell.
16975-the-haunted-house-a-true-ghost-sto.description: A book by Walter Hubbell.. Amherst, Nova Scotia, is a beautiful little village on the famous Bay of Fundy; has a population of about three thousand souls, and contains four churches, an academy, a music hall, a large iron foundry, a large shoe factory, and more stores of various kinds than any village of its size in the Province.

arxiv-1705-00597.title: Towards well-specified semi-supervised model-based classifiers via structural adaptation
arxiv-1705-00597.creator: Zhaocai Sun, William K. Cheung, Xiaofeng Zhang
arxiv-1705-00597.description: Abstract Semi-supervised learning plays an important role in large-scale machine learning. Properly using additional unlabeled data (largely available nowadays) often can improve the machine learning accuracy. However, if the machine learning model is misspecified for the underlying true data distribution, the model performance could be seriously jeopardized. This issue is known as model misspecification.

arxiv-2105-14973.creator: Timothée Poisot, Marie-Andrée Ouellet, Nardus Mollentze, Maxwell J. Farrell, Daniel J. Becker, Liam Brierley, Gregory F. Albery, Rory J. Gibb, Stephanie N. Seifert, Colin J. Carlson

Gibb, Stephanie N. Seifert, Colin J. Carlson. At most 1-2% of the global virome has been sampled to date. Recent work has shown that predicting which host-virus interactions are possible but undiscovered or unrealized is, fundamentally, a network science problem.

arxiv-2204-03438.title: Influence of the magnetic field on the formation of protostellar disks
arxiv-2204-03438.creator: *, Khaibrakhmanov S. A, Dudorov A. E., Zamozdra S. N, Zhilkin A. G
arxiv-2204-03438.description: Abstract We numerically model the collapse of magnetic rotating protostellar clouds with mass of 10 M ⊙ M_{\odot} . The simulations are carried out with the help of 2D MHD code Enlil. The structure of the cloud at the isothermal stage of the collapse is investigated for the cases of weak, moderate, and strong initial magnetic field.

arxiv-2204-06712.creator: Deepak, Arpita Chatterjee
arxiv-2204-06712.description: Abstract We consider an experimentally obtainable SUP operator, defined by using a generalized superposition of products of field annihilation ( a a ) and creation ( a † a^{\dagger} ) operators of the type, A = s ​ a ​ a † + t ​ a † ​ a A=saa^{\dagger}+t{a^{\dagger}}a with s 2 + t 2 = 1 s^{2}+t^{2}=1 .

arxiv-2205-04777.title: Polarized image of synchrotron radiations of hotspots in Schwarzschilld-Melvin black hole spacetime
arxiv-2205-04777.creator: Hu Zhu, Minyong Guo
arxiv-2205-04777.description: Abstract We revisit the innermost stable circular orbits (ISCOs) of charged particles and study the polarized images of synchrotron radiations emitted from such orbiting hotspots on the equatorial plane in Schwarzchild-Melvin black hole spacetime. We obtain a constraint on the magnetic field to retain ISCOs for charged particles.

arxiv-2206-07551.title: Unknown-Aware Domain Adversarial Learning for Open-Set Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2206-07551.creator: JoonHo Jang, Byeonghu Na, DongHyeok Shin, Mingi Ji, Kyungwoo Song, Il-Chul Moon
arxiv-2206-07551.description: Abstract Open-Set Domain Adaptation (OSDA) assumes that a target domain contains unknown classes, which are not discovered in a source domain. Existing domain adversarial learning methods are not suitable for OSDA because distribution matching with unknown classes leads to negative transfer. Previous OSDA methods have focused on matching the source and the target distribution by only utilizing known classes.

arxiv-2305-06213.title: Motivation, inclusivity, and realism should drive data science education
arxiv-2305-06213.description: Abstract Data science education provides tremendous opportunities but remains inaccessible to many communities. Increasing the accessibility of data science to these communities not only benefits the individuals entering data science, but also increases the field’s innovation and potential impact as a whole.

arxiv-2406-13839.title: RNA-FrameFlow : Flow Matching for de novo 3D RNA Backbone Design
arxiv-2406-13839.creator: Rishabh Anand, Chaitanya K. Joshi, Alex Morehead, Arian R. Jamasb, Charles Harris, Simon V. Mathis, Kieran Didi, Rex Ying, Bryan Hooi, Pietro Liò * Equal contribution
arxiv-2406-13839.description: Abstract We introduce RNA-FrameFlow , the first generative model for 3D RNA backbone design. We build upon S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) flow matching for protein backbone generation and establish protocols for data preparation and evaluation to address unique challenges posed by RNA modeling.

arxiv-2505-13899.title: Causes and Consequences of Representational Similarity in Machine Learning Models
arxiv-2505-13899.creator: Zeyu Michael Li *, Hung Anh Vu *, Damilola Awofisayo, Emily Wenger
arxiv-2505-13899.description: Abstract Numerous works have noted similarities in how machine learning models represent the world, even across modalities. Although much effort has been devoted to uncovering properties and metrics on which these models align, surprisingly little work has explored causes of this similarity.

arxiv-2507-00431.title: Simply slicing knots
arxiv-2507-00431.creator: Anthony Conway, Patrick Orson, Mark Pencovitch
arxiv-2507-00431.description: Abstract . Given a simply-connected 4 4 -manifold with boundary the 3 3 -sphere, this paper establishes sufficient conditions for a knot in the boundary to be sliced by a locally flat disc in the 4 4 -manifold, whose complement has finite cyclic fundamental group.

arxiv-2511-06692.title: Peeling Context from Cause for Multimodal Molecular Property Prediction
arxiv-2511-06692.creator: Tao Li, Kaiyuan Hou & Tuan Vinh, Carl Yang & Monika Raj
arxiv-2511-06692.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tao Li, Kaiyuan Hou & Tuan Vinh, Carl Yang & Monika Raj. Deep models are used for molecular property prediction, yet they are often hard to interpret and may rely on spurious context rather than causal structure, which degrades reliability under distribution shift and harms predictive performance. We introduce CLaP , Causal Layerwise Peeling , a framework which separates causal signal from context in a layerwise manner and integrates diverse graph representations of molecules.

arxiv-2511-21440.title: Antiferromagnetism and Kekulé valence bond order in the honeycomb optical Su-Schrieffer-Heeger-Hubbard model
arxiv-2511-21440.creator: Sohan Malkaruge Costa, Benjamin Cohen-Stead, Steven Johnston
arxiv-2511-21440.description: Abstract The precise role of electron-phonon ( e e -ph) coupling in graphene and related materials on a honeycomb lattice is not yet fully understood, despite extensive research on these systems. Here, we perform sign-problem-free determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the optical Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (oSSH) -Hubbard model on the honeycomb lattice, focusing on the parameters relevant to graphene.

pmc-10608930.title: Yeast Peptides Improve the Intestinal Barrier Function and Alleviate Weaning Stress by Changing the Intestinal Microflora Structure of Weaned Lambs
pmc-10608930.creator: Yanjun Li, Lulu Han, Jie Liu, Lingyun Kang, Ling Zhao, Kai Cui
pmc-10608930.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Early weaning stress in lambs leads to decreased feed intake, damage to intestinal morphology, changes in the microbial flora structure, and subsequent complications. Yeast peptides are antimicrobial peptides with anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and bacteriostasis effects. To study the effects of yeast peptides on relieving weaning stress in lambs, 54 lambs were randomly divided into three groups: ewe-reared (ER), yeast-peptide-treated (AP), and early-weaned (EW) lambs. The body weight and dry matter intake did not significantly differ among all groups.

pmc-10771270.description: Background: The notion that "age is just a number" is sometimes expressed colloquially; however, within the domains of medicine and dentistry, age is not only a numerical value. Rather, it has significant importance in several facets of diagnosis and treatment planning.

pmc-11653218.title: Posteromedial corner injuries result in the same posterior translation as posterolateral corner injuries in PCL ruptures
pmc-11653218.creator: Olivia Bohe, Frederik Greve, Svenja Höger, Julian Mehl, Sebastian Siebenlist, Lukas Willinger
pmc-11653218.description: PurposeRuptures of the posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) are often accompanied by posterolateral corner (PLC) and posteromedial corner (PMC) injuries. This study investigates the incidence and impact of PMC and PLC injuries on posterior tibial translation (PTT). It was hypothesized that PMC injuries are more common and impactful than previously reported.

The VNC of newly hatched larvae contains a set of 22 motoneurons organized into three distinct classes (DD, DA, and DB) that show consistent positioning and arrangement.

pmc-13538621.creator: Hsiu-Ching Hsu, Wen-Hui Fang, Meng-Chang Lee, Wei-Teing Chen, Yu-Hsuan Chen, Hsiao-Ting Lin, Chih-Chien Wang, Syu-Bi Lin, Cheng-Jung Chen, Mei-Jung Chen, Sui-Lung Su
pmc-13538621.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Physical activity is widely recommended to maintain muscle health in older adults, yet its effects may vary depending on genetic background. The ACTN3 R577X polymorphism leads to α-actinin-3 deficiency in XX homozygotes and may influence skeletal muscle performance. We examined the association between physical activity and muscle mass and function in 682 community-dwelling adults aged ≥ 65 years who participated in annual health examinations between 2021 and 2024.
